name: ferc-elibrary
description: Search, cache, and read public FERC eLibrary filings from Claude Desktop.
long_description:
Search the public FERC eLibrary, sync docket sheets into a shared document store, and read filings in bounded chunks.

**Public documents only** — no FERC login, and no CEII, privileged, or protected content. Files are cached under the store root you choose (default: `Downloads/ferc-elibrary`). Use `read_document` with page or character bounds for large filings; never pull full text in one call.

Ask Claude in plain language, for example:
- Sync docket CP21-470 and show what is cached
- Search within a 500-page order for "surplus service"
- Download the public PDF for an accession number

FERC does not publish an official developer API. This extension uses the same public website backend, which can change without notice.

tools.name: search_filings
tools.description: Search public FERC eLibrary filings by keyword, docket, accession, document type, category, or industry.

tools.name: get_docket
tools.description: Fetch a docket sheet: related filings, applicants, accession numbers, and cache status.

tools.name: get_filing
tools.description: Fetch metadata for one accession (YYYYMMDD-NNNN), including cache and extraction stats.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files attached to an accession. Call before downloading.

tools.name: get_filing_text
tools.description: Deprecated bounded text read. Prefer read_document with explicit bounds.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Return bounded plain text from a cached filing attachment.

tools.name: search_within_document
tools.description: Search extracted text and return passages with page and character offsets.

tools.name: get_document_outline
tools.description: Return PDF bookmarks or a heuristic section map.

tools.name: sync_docket
tools.description: Incrementally fetch accessions missing from the document store for a docket.

tools.name: cache_status
tools.description: Report what the document store holds for a docket or accession.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Cache one public file, a one-accession zip, or a generated PDF to the store.

tools.name: download_bundle
tools.description: Zip & Download many public files across accessions into the store.

tools.name: collect_related
tools.description: Search a term or document type, then group related filings by docket.

prompts.name: search_comments
prompts.description: Search eLibrary for comments and protests about a topic
prompts.text: Search the public FERC eLibrary for comments and protests about ${arguments.topic} in the last year. Summarize who filed and what they argued.

prompts.name: docket_sheet
prompts.description: Pull a docket sheet and list related filings
prompts.text: Pull the public FERC eLibrary docket sheet for ${arguments.docket} and list the related filings in chronological order, with accession numbers.

prompts.name: download_accession
prompts.description: Download the public files for an accession number
prompts.text: Download the public files for FERC eLibrary accession ${arguments.accession} to my download folder. Tell me the saved path.

download_dir.title: Store root
download_dir.description: Document store root for cached FERC filings. The folder is created automatically if it does not exist. Point this at a shared folder or S3-synced directory for firm-wide cache.
